en.quote: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention. Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
en.riddle: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold
en.speaker: Habakkuk
